params.prompt:
Original detailed cinematic manga for ZERO-SUM: OMEN. Meticulous variable-weight black ink, selective crosshatching and controlled halftone, expressive anatomy and hands, clear perspective, tactile brass machinery and repaired clothing, matte gouache architectural depth, restrained colour accents. Serious action has weight and aftermath; comedy uses stillness and simplified expression. Teen-rated peril, no gore or sexualization. Preserve supplied character identity and asymmetric props. English left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Exact rectangular layout follows the coordinates below, with clean white gutters. Draw NO lettering, numerals, logos, sound effects, speech balloons, captions, HUD or readable signs. Leave quiet upper areas for separate lettering. Every required digit and word is a later vector layer. No imitation of a named artist or existing franchise. NIL uses they/them, RIGHT decoder, one orange hair streak, three abacus clasps, longer LEFT coat tail. Vesper has LEFT braid, two blank hat cards, seven-chamber gun. Varro is human under a repaired hound mask, with three jars. Never mirror these actors.
Colour script: rain blue outside, warm paper interior, tiny amber lamp.
Panel p005_01 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.05, 0.9, 0.26]: Ama/Tobi flee down lit side passage. NIL sprints opposite; Collector turns late. Escape geography clear.
Panel p005_02 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.33, 0.9, 0.18]: NIL longer coat tail catches a nail for one deadpan beat, no injury or extra mechanical cost.
Panel p005_03 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.53, 0.43, 0.2]: Shrine door opens, Nought ink-stained hand reaches out, patched collar and worn brass latch.
Panel p005_04 at normalized rectangle [0.52, 0.53, 0.43, 0.2]: Nought pulls NIL in as Collector boots pass far edge; door outside their sightline.
Panel p005_05 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.75, 0.9, 0.2]: Still warm interior: blank Naming terminal, candle cup, repaired chair, ledgers as door wedges. Nought latches door while NIL frees coat.
Use an exact1000x1500 composition grid (scale proportionally to the output). Panel pixel boxes [x,y,w,h]: p005_01 [50, 75, 900, 390]; p005_02 [50, 495, 900, 270]; p005_03 [50, 795, 430, 300]; p005_04 [520, 795, 430, 300]; p005_05 [50, 1125, 900, 300]. Keep all art inside these boxes; gutters remain plain paper.
FINAL CONTINUITY: Draw ONLY this page's listed story cast: nil, brother_nought, collector. Brother Nought: older bald man, faded STEEL-GREY robe with missing seals, ink-stained hands and a die pendant; ONLY appears when this page explicitly lists him. Collector: HUMAN clerk-enforcer, black/brass rigid uniform with peaked cap, mechanical jar; not a demon. Do not add other named characters from style notes or other pages. The priest must NOT appear before the shrine entrance scene. Every mechanical readout is EMPTY SMOKED GLASS, never a portrait mirror; Civic/Audit/NaN lettering is added later. Preserve panel count, geometry and required geography. Clean 4K portrait page, no lettering, no balloons. Broad clean upper panel areas for separate text, faces/hands placed below those zones. Fine controlled ink detail at focal areas; strong black shapes and selective crosshatching; readable painted atmosphere, no glossy photorealism.
